# `traffic_mirror`

Mirrors bounded request/response bodies to an external collector.

## Configuration Notes

See the [module documentation](self) for capture semantics and the envelope shape.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `url` | string | yes | Absolute HTTP(S) URL of the collector endpoint that mirror records are delivered to. Validated at construction time; see [`validate_config`]. |
| `timeout_seconds` | integer | no | Delivery timeout in seconds. One budget covers DNS, connect, and I/O for the POST. Delivery is fire-and-forget: the timeout bounds a background task, never the proxied request. |
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | no | Maximum bytes of each body captured into the mirror record. The cap applies separately to the request body and the response body; bytes past the cap are counted (`body_bytes`) but not included, and the record is marked `truncated: true`. |
| `allow_private_addresses` | bool | no | Allow the collector to resolve to a private, loopback, or link-local address. Defaults to `false`; set to `true` explicitly when a trusted loopback collector (e.g. a local `MLflow` adapter) is the intended destination. Cloud-metadata, unspecified, and multicast addresses remain blocked even when enabled. |

## Example

```yaml
filter: traffic_mirror
url: "http://collector:9090/ingest"
timeout_seconds: 5             # optional, default 5
max_body_bytes: 1048576        # optional, default 1 MiB per body
allow_private_addresses: false # optional, default false
```
